rows.notice:
- ผู้ป่วย SMI-V ทั้งหมดที่เข้าเณฑ์และยังมีชีวิตอยู่ ณ ปัจจุบัน
- ตัดผู้เสียชีวิตจากฐานข้อมูลกระทรวงมหาดไทย และผู้ป่วย SMI-V อายุเกิน 60 ปี นับตั้งแต่วันเกิด จนถึงสิ้นสุดปีงบประมาณ

zone.label: เขตสุขภาพ
zone.query: SELECT h.zone_code as a_code, h.zone_name as a_name, SUM(pop) AS pop, SUM(new) AS c, SUM(old) AS b, SUM(all_cid) AS d, SUM(not_repeat_cid) AS f, SUM(follow_1) AS j, SUM(not_repeat1) AS k, SUM(follow_2) AS m, SUM(not_repeat2) AS n, ROUND(SUM(pop) * (4.37 / 100) * (11.92 / 100), 0) AS i FROM chospital as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode WHERE s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) GROUP BY h.zone_code, h.zone_name ORDER BY h.zone_code

province.label: จังหวัด
province.query: SELECT h.chw_code as a_code, h.chw_name as a_name, SUM(pop) AS pop, SUM(new) AS c, SUM(old) AS b, SUM(all_cid) AS d, SUM(not_repeat_cid) AS f, SUM(follow_1) AS j, SUM(not_repeat1) AS k, SUM(follow_2) AS m, SUM(not_repeat2) AS n, ROUND(SUM(pop) * (4.37 / 100) * (11.92 / 100), 0) AS i FROM chospital as h LEFT JOIN {{S_TABLE}} as s ON h.hoscode = s.hospcode WHERE s.b_year = {{YEAR}} AND ( h.zone_code = {{ZONE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{ZONE_CODE}} ) AND ( h.chw_code = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} or 'ALL' = {{PROVINCE_CODE}} ) GROUP BY h.chw_code, h.chw_name ORDER BY h.chw_code
